title: Power Rangers Season 13 S.P.D.
description: In the future, the people of Earth welcome extraterrestrial beings to live with them. But peace is short-lived when the alien forces become destructive, driving the Power Rangers SPD into action.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x1
episodes_data.description: Three experienced B-Squad cadets, Sky, Bridge and Syd, are assigned to bring in a pair of criminals who, just like them, happen to possess genetic powers of their own.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x2
episodes_data.description: When the evil Emperor Gruumm attempts to open a portal and invade the Earth, the three cadets are promoted and given Delta Morphers to become the Blue (Sky), Green (Bridge), and Pink Rangers (Syd), respectively. When the two criminals Z and Jack are recruited as the Yellow and Red Rangers, the S.P.D. B-Squad Power Rangers unite.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x3
episodes_data.description: Jack discovers the advantages of being the Red Ranger and begins to heavily abuse his position. Having been charged with defending the planet now that their elite A-Squad counterparts have disappeared while on a mission in the Helix Nebula, Jack's teammates call his leadership skills into question and he is stripped of his leader status and Ranger powers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x4
episodes_data.description: Still reeling from the shock of losing his chance at being the Red Ranger, Sky refuses to take part in group activities. He loses temper almost completely once Jack and Bridge are granted sleek, new Patrol Cycles. Meanwhile, Gruumm plans to steal diamonds to convert them into energy.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x5
episodes_data.description: Syd is the only one that believes R.I.C., the robotic dog, can still be a valuable asset to S.P.D.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x6
episodes_data.description: The other Rangers are skeptical of Bridge's unusual investigative methods.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x7
episodes_data.description: Mora uses a young boy with special powers in a plot to capture people and turn them into dolls.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x8
episodes_data.description: Z befriends Sam, and teaches him to use his special powers for the good of mankind.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x9
episodes_data.description: Sky's loyalty to an old friend is put to the test when it is suspected that he is working for Gruumm.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x10
episodes_data.description: Syd is angry with Jack when she makes him work on her birthday.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x11
episodes_data.description: Cruger must face the demons of his past when an old enemy returns.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x12
episodes_data.description: Cruger is challenged by an old foe and must overcome his reluctance to fight.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x13
episodes_data.description: Cruger refuses to help the Rangers fight Dracel; Gruumm goes after the Stone of Evil.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x14
episodes_data.description: A new recruit has SPD buzzing; Gruumm looks for a second in command.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x15
episodes_data.description: The teens must find Sophie before Valko uses her to control Gorodon.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x16
episodes_data.description: Trouble results when Boom tells his visiting parents that he is a Power Ranger.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x17
episodes_data.description: A dangerous alien criminal switches bodies with Sky.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x18
episodes_data.description: Gruumm brings a noble warrior from the past and tricks him into battling the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x19
episodes_data.description: Cruger is relieved from duty when he clashes with the tough SPD Supreme Commander.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x20
episodes_data.description: The Rangers relate the capture of a criminal to Cruger, but they all have their own unique version of the story.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x21
episodes_data.description: The cadets get a message from the future that today is the day that they will lose the battle of Earth to the Troobians.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x22
episodes_data.description: A mysterious Ranger from the future comes to help the Rangers in their hour of need.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x23
episodes_data.description: Morgana grants real power to a washed-up magician in her latest attempt to destroy the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x24
episodes_data.description: Sky must interrogate a notorious criminal when aliens that SPD has already captured attack the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x25
episodes_data.description: Sky must face off with the criminal who was responsible for the loss of his father.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x26
episodes_data.description: Piggy and friends steal SPD technology; the Rangers are sent to Zentor to train for SWAT mode.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x27
episodes_data.description: Under the command of a tough drill sergeant, the Rangers must learn to work as a team before they can earn a powerful new weapons' technology.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x28
episodes_data.description: The Rangers nearly reach their breaking point when both Gruumm and Broodwing send robot after robot to attack the city.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x29
episodes_data.description: Jack and Sky embark on a dangerous mission to stop an incoming meteor from destroying Earth.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x30
episodes_data.description: Convinced that the Rangers no longer need her, Kat takes a top-level position at SPD Headquarters.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x31
episodes_data.description: Bridge is captured and the other Rangers must use all their skills to find him before he is destroyed.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x32
episodes_data.description: Broodwing brings the Dino Rangers from the past to fight on the side of evil.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x33
episodes_data.description: Cruger's old rival teams up with Broodwing to take down the Rangers one by one.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x34
episodes_data.description: The teens grapple with failure after Cruger hails the A squad.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x35
episodes_data.description: Jack needs to decide what he really wants to do with his life and the Rangers are dealt a shocking revelation.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x36
episodes_data.description: With Cruger captured, the A Squad is sent by Gruumm to finish off the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x37
episodes_data.description: Omni descends to Earth and Gruumm makes his last stand against the Rangers.

episodes_data.title: Power Rangers S.P.D. 13x38
episodes_data.description: Gruumm takes The Terror to the past in an attempt to defeat Earth before SPD was formed.
